text:
maya: Hey team — final QA on BluePeak co-marketing assets before we push to Marketplace tomorrow. Pinged BluePeak legal already. Need quick checks: logo lockups, alt text for images, legal badge placement, case study quote attribution, and marketplace tile (1200x627) compression. I'll attach links to svgs/pngs. Also note SI integration diagram needs simplified labels for non-technical buyers.

trent: Got it — will review lockups and dark/bg variants. Any constraints on safe area?

maya: BluePeak requested 16px clearspace around horizontal and square marks. They prefer horizontal lockup on light bg and stacked on dark. Do not recolor logos; use BluePeak primary hex #003E7E for CTAs.

trent: Copy that. I'll also export 2x and 3x png for retina. Quick Q: can we use the BluePeak icon alone in social tiles?

ana: Legal here — BluePeak's partner guidelines allow icon usage for co-marketing if we include partner mark + a line: "Powered by BluePeak" and partner approval. They already signed the quote but need final sign-off on the case study paragraph. Also include trademark notice: "BluePeak is a registered trademark of BluePeak Inc."

maya: Thanks Ana. I have the signed approval email — forwarding to @ana now. Also need accessibility alt text for three images. Suggested alt texts below.

marco: On SI note — solution architecture diagram uses internal names. I'll simplify labels to: "Redwood Inference (model serving)", "BluePeak Compute", "Customer App". Add caption for Marketplace: "Redwood + BluePeak: low-latency inference for regulated workloads."

trent: Here's the alt text I'm proposing:
```
1) alt="Diagram: Redwood Inference runtime connected to BluePeak Compute, showing low-latency model serving."
2) alt="Case study hero: BluePeak logo and customer quote from a customer on reduced token cost."
3) alt="Marketplace tile: Redwood and BluePeak logos with 'Now Available in BluePeak Marketplace'."
```

maya: Nice. Ana, can you OK the trademark and alt text copy?

ana: Trademark line OK. Alt text: avoid naming the customer unless we have explicit permission. Which customer is that? Do we have permission to call out HelioLabs? If not, redact to "a customer".

maya: We do have HelioLabs permission — contract clause 5.2. I'll attach the signed clause to the ticket.

marketing-bot: :thumbsup: Reminder: final assets must be placed under /marketing/partners/bluepeak/ and follow filename pattern bp_redwood_<asset>_v1.2.png before 10:00 PT.

trent: Also found small issue: social tile contrast for CTA (#003E7E on #041022) is ~3.8:1 — below AA for small text. Suggest switching CTA text to white and keeping CTA background color.

maya: Good catch. Switch CTA text to white and update comps. Also reduce file size for marketplace tile to <300KB — use 8-bit PNG + pngquant.

marco: For the solution brief PDF, add final author attribution and a short blurb about deployment options: Hosted, Dedicated, Private. BluePeak asked to emphasize Dedicated compatibility. Add a callout box on pg 2.

trent: I pushed updated SVG lockups with 16px clearspace (link: https://redwood.assets/bluepeak/lockup-horiz-v3.svg). Please review.

maya: Quick publish checklist before go-live:
- Logo variants verified (trent) ✅
- Trademark/legal copy (ana) ✅
- Alt text (trent) ✅
- Marketplace tile optimized <300KB (trent) ✅
- Solution brief callout added (marco) ✅
- Partner approval email attached (maya) ✅
- Final filenames & folder structure set (marketing-bot) ✅

ana: One more: include partner privacy contact on the marketplace listing. BluePeak privacy@bluepeak.com.

maya: All set — scheduling publish for 09:30 PT tomorrow and looping in BluePeak PM. Thanks everyone :tada:

trent: will QA the final PNGs tomorrow morning.

marco: sending final brief in the ticket now.

maya: closing thread once live. If anything blocks, ping me directly.
